news.headline: DU Pro-VC said it out loud: we are sticking to the old schedule. UGC asked to defer. DU said no.
UGC still sells January as the national start. Roughly 63,000 public first-year seats.
Under 48 hours to DU form open. If the submit button lights up at noon Wednesday, the war is operational.
Supplementary cohort was the whole point of UGC winter. DU December sprint mostly leaves them outside.
BUET last hard line 21 Nov / 16 Jan. After DU held, silence is a strategy.
Medical still answers to health education. Mid-December MBBS/BDS can still run.
Morning season postponed. Evening DU still opens Wednesday. Batch SMS is a crime scene.
DU eased some test subject marks and HSC grade floors — not a general amnesty.
1) DU portal noon Wednesday 2) BUET notice 3) Ministry pressure. Everything else is noise.
